name: DynamicNotch · 动态刘海
tagline: 让刘海承载通知、活动与可调玻璃外观。
notice: 仅推荐刘海屏且未开启灵动岛的设备安装。已开启原生或模拟灵动岛的设备不建议安装。 用户已在 iOS 15、16、17、18 上测试；iOS 26 仍待设备验证。低电量模式或减少透明度开启时，玻璃会使用黑底。
description: DynamicNotch 将通知、音乐、通话和计时等活动显示在刘海区域，保留系统状态栏。
提供紧凑提示、长按展开与独立玻璃外观，可按需选择活动类型和通知呈现方式。
features: 整合通知、音乐、通话、计时器、秒表、录音、录屏、静音与音量等提示
支持专注／勿扰、系统开关及 Apple Watch 充电状态提示
支持可用的实时活动紧凑显示与长按展开
通知正文自动换行，可选自动展开，点击执行系统默认操作
独立玻璃外观，可调填充、模糊、折射、厚度与边缘高光
支持上划收起／隐藏及恢复仍在进行的隐藏活动
支持简体中文、繁體中文和 English 设置
compatibility: 仅推荐刘海屏、未开启灵动岛（含模拟灵动岛）的设备
支持目标 iOS 15–26；用户已测试 iOS 15、16、17、18
部分活动与控制依系统版本和 App 支持而定
音乐波形需要 BananaAudioService 1.0.4 或更新版本
与原版 DynamicNotch 不可同时安装
usage: 安装后前往“设置 → 动态刘海”启用并选择需要的活动类型。
通知接管默认关闭，需要时开启通知及自动展开选项。
轻点进入对应内容，长按展开，上划收起／隐藏；可在设置恢复仍在进行的隐藏活动。
开启玻璃后显示参数；低电量模式或减少透明度开启时使用黑底。

changes: 新增专注／勿扰、系统开关及 Apple Watch 充电提示。
改善通知 App 图标、来电自动展开与刘海两侧留白。
优化铃声、静音及音量提示接管，减少自动调音量时的重复状态反馈。
首个 Beta 公开测试版，支持通知、音乐、通话、计时及实时活动等刘海提示。
提供独立玻璃外观、参数调整和通知自动展开，优化点击跳转与活动控制。
提供 RootHide 与 Rootless 双版本；用户已在 iOS 16、17、18 上测试。

en.name: DynamicNotch
en.tagline: Notch notifications, activities and adjustable glass.
en.notice: Recommended only for notched iPhones with Dynamic Island disabled. Installation is not recommended when a native or simulated Dynamic Island is enabled. User-tested on iOS 15, 16, 17 and 18; iOS 26 still awaits device validation. Glass uses a black background while Low Power Mode or Reduce Transparency is enabled.
description: DynamicNotch brings notifications, music, calls and timers to the notch while keeping the system status bar.
Choose compact alerts, expanded views and independent glass styling, with configurable activity types and notification presentation.
features: Notifications, music, calls, timers, stopwatch, voice and screen recording, ringer and volume alerts
Focus / Do Not Disturb, system toggle and Apple Watch charging alerts
Compact and expanded views for supported Live Activities
Wrapped notification text, optional automatic expansion and native default actions on tap
Independent glass with adjustable fill, blur, refraction, thickness and edge highlights
Swipe to collapse or hide, and restore hidden activities that are still running
English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese Settings
compatibility: Recommended only for notched iPhones with native or simulated Dynamic Island disabled
Targets iOS 15–26; user-tested on iOS 15, 16, 17 and 18
Some activities and controls depend on the iOS version and app
Music waveforms require BananaAudioService 1.0.4 or later
Cannot be installed alongside the original DynamicNotch
usage: Open Settings → DynamicNotch after installation, enable it and choose your activity types.
Notification takeover is off by default; enable notifications and automatic expansion as needed.
Tap to open content, hold to expand, and swipe up to collapse or hide. Restore hidden ongoing activities from Settings.
Glass controls appear when glass is enabled. Low Power Mode or Reduce Transparency switches the background to black.

changes: Added Focus / Do Not Disturb, system toggle and Apple Watch charging alerts.
Improved notification app icons, automatic incoming-call expansion and compact notch spacing.
Improved ringer, silent-mode and volume alerts to reduce duplicate status feedback during volume automation.
First public beta with notch alerts for notifications, music, calls, timers and Live Activities.
Adjustable independent glass, optional notification auto-expansion, and improved opening and activity controls.
RootHide and Rootless packages, user-tested on iOS 16, 17 and 18.
